_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

910.name: Volcanic Origins and Early Settlement
910.label: Event
910.description: Volcanic archipelago formation in the Mozambique Channel; earliest Bantu and Austronesian settlers arrive.

910.name: Volcanic Formation of the Archipelago
910.label: Event
910.description: Formation of Grande Comore, Mohéli, Anjouan, and Mayotte through volcanic activity; Mount Karthala as active volcano.

910.name: Early Bantu and Austronesian Settlers
910.label: Event
910.description: Bantu-speaking peoples from East Africa and possible Austronesian influence; proto-Swahili settlements.

920.name: Swahili-Arab Sultanates
920.label: Event
920.description: Islamisation of the islands; establishment of competing sultanates; Shirazi and Arab merchant influence; integration into Indian Ocean trade networks.

920.name: Islamisation of the Comoros
920.label: Event
920.description: Arrival of Arab and Shirazi traders; conversion to Islam; oldest mosques built; Islamic culture becomes dominant.

920.name: Competing Sultanate System
920.label: Event
920.description: Multiple sultanates on each island; Ndzuwani (Anjouan) and Ngazidja (Grande Comore) most powerful; trade in slaves, spices, and ambergris.

930.name: European Contact and Sultanate Decline
930.label: Event
930.description: Portuguese sighting; Malagasy raids from Madagascar; internal sultanate warfare; gradual French interest.

930.name: Portuguese Contact
930.label: Event
930.description: Portuguese navigators visit the Comoros en route to India; limited lasting impact on the islands.

930.name: Malagasy Raids and Internal Conflicts
930.label: Event
930.description: Devastating Sakalava and Betsimisaraka raids from Madagascar; slave raiding; inter-sultanate warfare weakens islands.

940.name: French Colonial Comoros
940.label: Event
940.description: French protectorates then full colonisation; plantation economy (ylang-ylang, vanilla); administered from Madagascar.

940.name: Protectorates and Annexation
940.label: Event
940.description: France establishes protectorates over remaining islands; full annexation 1912; Comoros attached to Madagascar colony.

940.name: Plantation Economy
940.label: Event
940.description: French settlers establish ylang-ylang, vanilla, and clove plantations; forced labour; economic dependency on cash crops.

950.name: Independence and Mayotte Separation
950.label: Event
950.description: Unilateral declaration of independence 1975; Mayotte votes to remain French; Ali Soilih's revolutionary regime.

950.name: Independence Declaration
950.label: Event
950.description: Ahmed Abdallah declares independence 6 July 1975; three islands vote yes, Mayotte votes to stay French.

950.name: Ali Soilih Revolutionary Regime
950.label: Event
950.description: Ali Soilih overthrows Abdallah; radical socialist youth revolution; destruction of civil records; anti-tradition campaigns.

950.name: Bob Denard Mercenary Coups
950.label: Event
950.description: French mercenary Bob Denard dominates Comorian politics through serial coups; Abdallah restored then killed; instability.

950.name: 1978 Denard Coup and Abdallah Restoration
950.label: Event
950.description: Bob Denard overthrows Ali Soilih; restores Ahmed Abdallah; Denard commands presidential guard; Abdallah killed 1989.

950.name: 1995 Denard Coup Attempt
950.label: Event
950.description: Denard stages final coup; French military intervention restores order; Denard arrested and deported.

960.name: Island Separatism and Reconciliation
960.label: Event
960.description: Anjouan and Mohéli secessions; African Union intervention; new union constitution; ongoing inter-island tensions.

960.name: Anjouan and Mohéli Secessions
960.label: Event
960.description: Anjouan and Mohéli declare independence from Comoros 1997; OAU/AU mediation efforts.

960.name: Union of the Comoros Constitution
960.label: Event
960.description: 2001 Fomboni Accords; rotating presidency between islands; autonomous island governments; continued tensions.
